GitHub저장

Filled in once. The token stays in this browser only and never gets into the page itself.

Keep the key열쇠 보관

The key lives in this browser. If you open the page in another browser, on another phone, or straight from a downloaded file, save the key once and load it back in one tap.

The key file and the key link hold your token, so keep them to yourself and never put them into the repository. Progress itself comes back on its own: on every start the page reads progress.json from GitHub and merges it in.
How to make the key열쇠

The token is needed for writing only. Reading from a public repository works without it.

  1. On GitHub open Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained tokens.
  2. Press Generate new token. Name it study-progress, expiration 90 days or longer.
  3. Repository access: Only select repositories → pick the repository with this page.
  4. Repository permissions → Contents: Read and write. Nothing else is needed.
  5. Press Generate token and copy the line that starts with github_pat_. It is shown once.
  6. Paste it into Access token above and press Save to GitHub.
Never put the token into a file in the repository. If the phone is lost, open the same GitHub page and press Revoke - the key stops working.
New lessons새 메뉴

Drop a new lesson file next to this page in the repository and press the button. The page finds it, reads the section from the code and adds it to the list.

Codes are read like this: E English, B Bashkir, F philosophy terms, P philosophers, M map, G theory of state and law, S expertology, T tests. Everything else goes to «Other».
